Can Claude generate images? Not photos. Here are 4 visuals it builds instead: diagrams, charts, apps, image reading.

Can Claude generate images? No, but it builds 4 visuals. Here is what it makes instead.

1. Diagrams - Interactive diagrams, built with HTML and SVG.
2. Charts - Charts from your own data.
3. Apps - Small interactive apps, built as artifacts.
4. Image Reading - It reads and explains images you upload. Reading yes, drawing no.

Needs: Free, Pro, Max
